inboundMode.title: Inbound Mode
inboundMode.description: Choose websocket long-connection or webhook callback for inbound messages

region.title: Region
region.description: API endpoint region: feishu.cn or larksuite.com

homeserverUrl.title: Homeserver URL
homeserverUrl.description: Matrix homeserver base URL, e.g. https://matrix.example.com

enableInputHint.title: Input Hint
enableInputHint.description: Send QQ input-notify hints for direct messages while the bot is processing.

enableStreaming.title: Stream Messages
enableStreaming.description: Stream direct-message replies via QQ stream messages (typewriter effect). Falls back to a single buffered message on failure.

markdownSupport.title: Markdown Support
markdownSupport.description: Enable QQ markdown message mode for C2C and group replies when the bot has permission.

appToken.title: App-Level Token
appToken.description: Slack App-Level Token for Socket Mode (xapp-...)

apiBaseURL.title: API Base URL
apiBaseURL.description: Reverse proxy base URL for the Telegram Bot API. Required in regions where Telegram is blocked (e.g. China mainland). Default: https://api.telegram.org

httpProxyUrl.title: HTTP Proxy URL
httpProxyUrl.description: Optional outbound HTTP proxy URL for Telegram API requests, e.g. http://user:pass@host:port. Explicit adapter proxy overrides HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY.

httpProxyUrl.title: HTTP Proxy URL
httpProxyUrl.description: Optional outbound HTTP proxy URL for WeChat API requests, e.g. http://user:pass@host:port. Explicit adapter proxy overrides HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY.

acp_agent_id.description: ACPAgentID names the ACP agent when RuntimeType is acp_agent.

acp_model_id.description:
ACPModelID is an agent-reported model identifier override for External
Agent runs. Mutually exclusive with ModelID.

bot_agent_id.description:
BotAgentID selects one persisted BotAgent for a new session. Empty means
the built-in Native runtime (or the legacy ACP fields below).

max_run_seconds.description: MaxRunSeconds is the execution budget (300-86400 seconds); zero uses one hour.

model_id.description: ModelID is a native model UUID override (models.id).

reasoning_effort.description: ReasoningEffort overrides the reasoning effort for this schedule.

runtime_type.description:
RuntimeType selects the runtime for new sessions: "" or "model" for
the native model runtime, "acp_agent" for an ACP agent. Must be empty
in existing_session mode (inherited from the target session).

target_session_id.description: TargetSessionID names the session reused by existing_session mode.

workdir_id.description:
WorkdirID binds new sessions to a bot workdir. Must be empty in
existing_session mode (inherited from the target session).

execution.description:
Execution replaces the whole execution parameter block when present.
Field-level patching is deliberately not offered: the block carries
cross-field constraints (run target vs runtime vs workdir), so
callers send the full desired state and the service validates it as
one unit.

acp_agent_id.description: ACPAgentID names the ACP agent when RuntimeType is acp_agent.

acp_model_id.description:
ACPModelID is an agent-reported model identifier override for External
Agent runs. Mutually exclusive with ModelID.

bot_agent_id.description:
BotAgentID selects one persisted BotAgent for a new session. Empty means

model_id.description: ModelID is a native model UUID override (models.id).

enabled.description:
Enabled defaults to true when omitted. The web passes false for direct
runtimes so the dependency preflight runs before the agent goes live.

restore_data.description:
RestoreData imports the preserved /data archive into the new workspace
once it is running. Backends that expose snapshot mounts restore the
archive while starting regardless of this flag; the flag matters for
backends that restore through the bridge.

session_id.description: SessionID optionally routes operation progress to its originating conversation.

version.description:
Version to install. Empty (or no body) installs the latest version the
catalog script resolves, or the manifest pin when the dependency has
one. The version recorded afterwards is the one the script reports.

source_path.description:
SourcePath is the existing SKILL.md being edited when saving a single skill.
Empty means create (or overwrite by frontmatter name under
/data/skills/user/personal/<name>/).

granted.description: Granted forces Manage ON (true) or OFF (false) locally.

dependencies.description: Dependencies are updated to their latest version.

release.description: Release moves the installation to the registry's current release.

enabled.description:
Pointer so an empty or mistyped body fails validation instead of
silently disabling the connector.
